basic_details.organization_name: Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati (IIT Guwahati)
basic_details.short_information: The Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati (IIT Guwahati) has officially announced the SRF (Direct) Recruitment 2026 with 1 opening. The detailed notification has been published on the official website, https://www.iitg.ac.in. Candidates holding a Post Graduate degree in Basic Science or a Graduate/ Post Graduate Degree in a Professional Course with NET/ GATE or an equivalent national-level examination, along with 2 years of research experience in deep learning for computer vision, are eligible to apply. Interested candidates can submit their online applications on or before 05 August 2026. T

qualification.education_qualification: Post Graduate degree in basic science or Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course with NET/GATE or equivalent national level exam
qualification.details: SRF(Direct): Post Graduate degree in basic science or Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course selected through a process described through any one of the following: (1) Scholars selected through National Eligibility Test - CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) and GATE. (2) The selection process through National Level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DoS, DRDO, MHRD, ICAR, ICMR, IISc, IISCR etc. Additionally, 2 years of research experience in the area for the development of deep learning algorithms for real-time computer vision applications is required.

how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online on or before 05-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Guwahati to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the IIT Guwahati Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: IIT Guwahati SRF Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 1 vacancy is available – 1 for the SRF (Direct) post.

content_sections.heading: IIT Guwahati SRF Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: SRF(Direct): Post Graduate degree in basic science or Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course selected through a process described through any one of the following: (1) Scholars selected through National Eligibility Test - CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) and GATE. (2) The selection process through National Level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DoS, DRDO, MHRD, ICAR, ICMR, IISc, IISCR etc. Additionally, 2 years of research experience in the area for the development of deep learning algorithms for real-time computer vision applications is required.

content_sections.heading: IIT Guwahati SRF Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 05-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Guwahati to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Guwahati SRF(Direct) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the IIT Guwahati SRF(Direct) Recruitment 2026 is 05 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the SRF(Direct) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the SRF(Direct) post in the IIT Guwahati Recruitment 2026. This is a direct recruitment opportunity for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the SRF(Direct) position?
faq.answer: The required qualification is a Post Graduate degree in basic science or a Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in a Professional Course with NET/GATE or equivalent national level exam, along with 2 years of research experience in deep learning for computer vision.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the SRF(Direct) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the SRF(Direct) position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 51,650.00. This is a contractual position with a competitive remuneration package.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the IIT Guwahati SRF(Direct) Recruitment 2026 is online. Candidates need to apply through the official website or the provided application link.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the SRF(Direct) post?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any application charges.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the SRF(Direct) position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the SRF(Direct) post will be based on an Online Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience for the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIT Guwahati located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati is located in Guwahati, Assam, with the pincode 781039.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for the SRF(Direct) position at IIT Guwahati is contractual. This means the appointment will be for a specific period as per the terms of the contract.

faq.question: Q10. When is the online interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The online interview for the SRF(Direct) recruitment is scheduled to be held on 07 August 2026. Candidates should be prepared for the interview on this date.
